scope: Pinned candidate documentation and build definition only; no build, embedded source execution, model runtime or license clearance

findings.observed: Upstream explicitly requires audio.cpp-native tensor names, embedded metadata and family package spec; arbitrary llama.cpp/whisper.cpp GGUF is not a valid substitute
findings.action: Dedicated Audio/TTS Adapter and source-bound family/asset rules

findings.observed: Package-resource and option-contract selection orders differ; option contract can be discovered from working directory and parent directories
findings.action: Use pinned controlled spec override or validated embedded schema-v1 override, controlled working directory and component roots; audit actual loader before launch

findings.observed: CMake offers AUDIOCPP_BUILD_NATIVE_MODEL_MANAGER and an optional model manager
findings.action: Disable native model manager; all managed model files must come from the central ModelScope plan and transfer worker

findings.observed: AUDIOCPP_DEPLOYMENT_BUILD can compile family specs; optional static eSpeak flag is disabled by default and explicitly labeled GPL-3.0-or-later
findings.action: Pin engine/spec versions and record optional dependency license facts; do not infer commercial clearance

findings.observed: Actual GGUF samples contain source-file assets and package metadata; no embedded content has been executed
findings.action: Inspect native asset loader and reject executable discovery; test complete all-GGUF components with actual output before approval
